description: This is a test utility class for importing an integration module within the salesmanager project. It uses Spring test annotations and performs file I/O to read a JSON configuration, parse it into module objects, and update the module configuration service accordingly.

classes.name: ImportIntegrationModule
classes.description: A utility/test class for importing integration modules from a JSON file and updating the system's module configuration.

methods.name: importIntegrationModule
methods.description: Reads a JSON file containing integration modules, finds the module with code 'beanstream', and updates the system's module configuration accordingly. Annotated with @Ignore for testing purposes.
